plain: The breaking up of a nation or territory into parts.

webster.text: The act of severing a limb or limbs from the body; the act of tearing or cutting in pieces; mutilation; the act of severing a part from the main body; division; separation.

example.quote: On the dismemberment, which took place under his sons, this part was erected into a separate and independent empire.
example.cite: The Federalist No. 19 (Madison, with Hamilton), Dec. 8, 1787
